meta.description: Code-based inventory of all user-facing Blackout elements: client shell, custom feature modules, quick actions with preset gating, settings/customization, legacy compatibility, and persisted event/data keys.

coreClientShell.description: Primary layout elements of the blackout-client shell (ClientLayout). All surfaces are wired into the main client layout and rendered on both desktop and mobile unless noted.

elements.name: RoomTimeline
elements.description: Message display and virtualized timeline for the active room.

elements.name: DeadDropComposer
elements.description: Composer extension for queuing ephemeral dead-drop messages.

elements.name: OnboardingWizard

elements.name: WelcomeScreen
elements.description: Initial welcome screen rendered before room selection.

featureFlags.description: BlackoutFeature enum from _port/src/modules/blackout/featureFlags.ts. DEPRECATED — migrate to preset-based flags. isBlackoutFeatureEnabled() checks primary key then falls back to legacyAlias.

themeIds.description: Old theme IDs normalised to canonical IDs by normalizeThemeId() in packages/core/src/themes.ts. Theme parity confirmed by apps/blackout-client/src/app/features/settings/theme-parity.test.ts.

presetNames.description: Old tier-based preset names normalised by normalizeFeaturePresetKey() in apps/blackout-web/src/settings/feature-presets.ts.

apiAlias.description: Legacy /api/* route alias for /v1/*. Tracked in packages/api/src/telemetry/api-alias-usage.ts. Removal scheduled via API_ALIAS_REMOVAL_DATE env var.

legacyCallStack.description: Ported Element Web call UI components in _port/. Being replaced by the new call feature module in blackout-client.

themes.description: Built-in themes defined in packages/core/src/themes.ts. Legacy IDs are normalised at runtime.

current.label: Dark canopy
current.description: Deep green and black surfaces for extended low-light sessions.

current.label: Light grove
current.description: Light green and white surfaces for daylight readability.

current.label: AMOLED night
current.description: Pure black OLED surfaces with teal interaction accents.

current.label: Storybook meadow
current.description: Warm natural tones with soft highlights for calm reading and collaboration.

current.label: Adventure spectrum
current.description: Playful high-contrast accents and clear landmarks for color-blind-friendly navigation.

featurePresets.resolution: deployment → tenant override → user override (if allowlisted)

featureUiEntries.description: All 92 feature UI entrypoints from apps/blackout-web/src/settings/feature-entrypoints.ts, grouped by surface kind.

clientActions.description: Quick action IDs, preset gating, and invocation logic from apps/blackout-client/src/app/features/quick-actions/featureEntrypoints.ts.
clientActions.firstRunBehavior: getUnseenQuickActionIds() compares visible entry IDs against the seen set and returns unseen IDs for new-shortcut guidance. markQuickActionsSeen() persists to the seen key.
clientActions.collapsedBehavior: readQuickActionCollapsed() / writeQuickActionCollapsed() control the collapsed remember-state via the collapsed key.

entries.label: Threads
entries.description: Open thread panel for the active room.

radialMenu.description: 8-item circular radial menu from packages/core/src/quick-actions.ts (VineActions/RadialBloom UI).

settingsAndCustomization.description: Settings sections and all persisted customization atoms.

sections.description: Display name, avatar, password, email, connected accounts.
Theme, accent color, font scale, chat density, emoji style, timestamp visibility, message grouping.
Global mode, per-room overrides, desktop notifications, sound and volume, taskbar flash.
Blocked users, DM permissions, read receipts, typing indicators.
Preferred audio and video device selection.
Reduced motion, high-contrast, and other a11y toggles.
Keyboard shortcut viewer and rebind UI.
Dev mode, streamer mode, and diagnostic toggles.
App version, licenses, and build info.

theme.note: Normalised from legacy IDs on load.

otherUserDataKeys.description: Additional localStorage keys, Matrix account-data keys, and custom Matrix event types used across the client.

localStorage.description: Account data key for user-defined space ordering in the sidebar.
Per-space collapsed folder state. <spaceOrHome> is the space room ID or 'home'. One key per space.
Core AppSettings atom (theme, zoom, emoji, notifications, chat density, dev/streamer mode, layout widths, room list scope, A/V device prefs).
Active settings section atom (last open settings tab).
Stego settings: enabled toggle and saved passphrases.
Whether the quick action bar is collapsed.
JSON array of QuickActionId strings the user has already seen (for first-run guidance).

deaddrop.description: Room state: Dead Drop config — enabled, schedule (interval/cron/manual), anonymize, maxQueueSize, retentionHours.
Room state: Current queue depth (queueCount integer).
Room state: Operator command — { action: 'flush'|'clear', at: timestamp }.

governance.description: Per-user vote cast on a proposal.

roles.description: Named role definitions and assignments for a room.

profile.description: Extended user profile: banner, bio, pronouns, connections, decoration, roles.

matrixMessages.description: Custom msgtype for proposal messages in the timeline.
